item.title: Local LLMs on a 32 GB Mac: MLX, Qwen, and Making OpenCode Work With Them
item.description: I wanted a coding agent that works without the internet. Not for everything, only for simple daily tasks: read a few files, edit a few lines, write a short doc. My laptop is a Mac with an M1 Max and 32 GB of RAM. This post is what I learned: which models fit, how fast they are, and why OpenCode needed a fix before a local model could use it.
